verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated export feature, but files can leave Poly in usable forms. The desktop app exposes your Poly files as a real folder in Finder or Explorer that downloads and syncs automatically, Finder tags sync both ways with Poly tags, and Mind journal entries are stored as Markdown files. These are open, portable formats reachable without lock-in, though only indirectly. Missing for 10: a documented full export or takeout of the whole knowledge base, export of Poly Mind memory and the auto-extracted 'second brain' data, bulk export of version history, and any independent confirmation that leaving is lossless.
